businessDescription: All-in-one AI platform for workforce assessment and upskilling — skills assessments, candidate-to-role matching, bite-sized learning modules, and continuous evaluation in a single platform for companies that want to measure real potential and act on it.
voice: Direct and principle-driven — cuts through HR buzzwords to make a clear argument, backs it with data, and always connects insight to action.
targetAudience: HR leaders, L&D professionals, and CHROs at growth-stage and enterprise companies who are responsible for hiring quality, workforce development, and talent strategy — and are frustrated that assessment and upskilling have lived in separate tools that don't talk to each other.

hardConstraints.rule: Always cite sources inline with hyperlinks.
Never make up statistics — only use numbers that appear in the research notes.
hardConstraints.example: If no stat is found, write 'data unavailable' rather than estimating.

hardConstraints.rule: Every post must have a clear thesis stated in the introduction.
hardConstraints.example: First paragraph ends with a specific, defensible claim the post will prove.

hardConstraints.rule: Never reduce workforce topics to pure cost-cutting — always frame people development as a growth driver.
hardConstraints.example: Upskilling is not about cutting training budgets more efficiently. It's about making development land where it matters.

softPreferences.preference: Lead with the business problem, not the product category.
softPreferences.example: Don't start with 'skills-based hiring is trending.' Start with the specific pain that makes it necessary.

softPreferences.preference: Use the measurement-action framework as a recurring anchor.
softPreferences.example: When possible, tie arguments back to: you can't grow what you don't measure, and measuring without acting is just data collection.

softPreferences.preference: Be specific about what 'good' looks like — give decision-makers something concrete.
softPreferences.example: Instead of 'improve your hiring process,' say 'reduce time-to-productivity for new hires by starting assessment before day one.'

softPreferences.preference: Keep paragraphs under 5 sentences — HR leaders are busy and read on mobile between meetings.
softPreferences.example: Dense paragraphs lose the reader. Short paragraphs signal confidence.

avoidTopics: content that frames employees as cost centers rather than assets
surveillance-framed workforce monitoring (distinguish assessment from surveillance explicitly)

competitorTypes: traditional HR software with learning modules
